name: Jarman Sales & Service, Inc.
category: Air conditioning sales, installation, and service
hours: Mon to Fri 8 am to 4:30 pm. Sat 8 am to noon. Closed Sun.
description: Jarman Sales & Service has been family-owned and operated in South Philadelphia since 1951, the leading Friedrich dealer for window units, through-the-wall units, custom installations, retrofits, maintenance, and winter storage.

hero.headline: Window and wall units for Philadelphia, since 1951
hero.sub: Family-owned for 75 years and the leading Philadelphia dealer for Friedrich, America's best air conditioner.

offerings.heading: What Jarman <mark>installs and keeps running.</mark>
items: Window units and through-the-wall units, sold and installed
Custom installations and retrofitting for rowhomes and apartments
Heat pumps, electric heat, and PTAC models, plus offseason maintenance and winter storage
Leading Friedrich dealer in the Philadelphia area
Mon to Fri 8 to 4:30, Sat 8 to noon

story.heading: The shop that outlasted central air
paragraphs: Jarman opened on Point Breeze Avenue in 1951 and is still family-owned. Rowhomes need window and wall units, and Jarman installs them right.
Offseason maintenance, retrofits, and winter storage are why customers stay.

experience.heading: How it works
items: Call or book online; Jarman measures.
Pick the Friedrich model; the shop's crew installs it.
Maintenance and winter storage on request.

feature.heading: Through-the-wall units, retrofitted
feature.text: Old sleeves, odd sizes, and brick walls are the specialty. Jarman retrofits the opening and fits the unit so it looks like it was always there.
